other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen
Applicant must hold a master's degree in biotechnology or a related field from a recognized university
Applicant must have cleared the GAT or NET exam in biotechnology or a related field
Applicant must be willing to pursue full-time doctoral research in biotechnology or a related field at a recognized university or research institution in India
Age limit: up to 28 years for general and EWS candidates, up to 33 years for SC, ST, and PH candidates
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹31,000 for the first two years and ₹35,000 for the remaining three years.
